📌 Karaj, IRNA – Deputy Parliament Speaker Ali Nikzad says Iran remains determined to fight the foreign aggressors until complete victory, noting that the enemies do not yet know the Armed Forces and the people of the Islamic Republic.

Speaking at a ceremony in the city of Taleghan on Thursday, Nikzad said the Iranian nation stood firmly against the US and Israeli enemies, who had the illusion of capturing Tehran in three days, with their divisive plots and an imposed war.
​
He said the aggressors had failed to understand the Islamic Republic of Iran and its people, who, through resistance, resilience, and following the path of Imams and martyrs, made US-led military and economic pressures ineffective.
​
Referring to anti-Iran conspiracies hatched by the US and its allies, Nikzad said they have neither succeeded in changing the map of the West Asia region, nor in bringing Iran’s oil export to zero as they claimed.
​
Despite challenges, Iranians are working hard and supporting their Armed Forces against the United States, which, with the support of some of its allies, tried to destroy Iran, he noted, adding that the Iranian nation, trained by the martyred Leader in defense, politics, and other fields, knew how to deal with the enemies.
​
